messages:
Alex: FYI -- canary perf spike after yesterday’s matmul slotting heuristic merge. 95th token latency +20% on mixed KV workload.
Maria: Which merge? PR number? Any traces?
Alex: PR #842 -- new slotting + allocator tweaks. Attached nsys & perfetto links. Short trace summary:
```
nsys: repeated large cublasLtMatmul launches, some requesting 600-800MB workspace, followed by cudaMallocAsync bursts and mempool fallbacks
Timeline: matmul kernels serializing around allocations, midbatch host-side stalls
```
Sam: Huh. Our splitK decision logic might be picking a block algorithm that needs temporary workspace when shapes are noisy.
Jin: Also saw KV cache rehydration hitting midbatch; kv warmup creates interleaved small seqs, changes shape distribution, so probe picks different algo.
Maria: So interplay: slotting heuristic + allocator changes => higher variance in ws requests => cudaMallocAsync churn => kernel serialization.
Alex: Yes. nsys flame shows cublasLtPlanCreate/Transform heavy, and then cudaMallocAsync spikes right before cublasLtMatmul.
Sam: Quick local repro: forcing ENV CUBLASLT_ALGO=DEFAULT reduces ws and latency returns near baseline. But we need a safe programmatic fix.
Maria: Short-term rollback for canary? Or disable probing for shapes under 256 for now.
Alex: Requested rollback scheduled with @deploy-bot. Also proposing feature flags: (1) ws_soft_cap per-device, (2) backoff on algo_probe when ws variance > 30%, (3) allocator compaction on low-util periods.
Jin: I'll add metrics: ws_requested_bytes, ws_variance_ratio, probe_attempts, cudaMallocAsync_events. Exporter + trace annotations.
Sam: Another mitigation: when probe chooses ws-heavy algo and mempool can't satisfy, fallback should pick the next-best algo without triggering mallocs in the hot path.
Maria: Agree. Add a guard in runtime: if probe_estimated_ws > available_mempool*0.6 then pick safer algo.
Alex: Filed tracking issue #1678 with nsys/perfetto links and a minimal repro harness (mixed seq lengths + KV on/off).
perf-bot: performance alert created: canary-matmul-95p-up-20pct (muted after rollback)
deploy-bot: @alex rollback to previous slotting heuristic scheduled at 03:10 UTC for canary. Will update when done.
Maria: After rollback, let's run a 1-hour soak with randomized seqs and KV on to validate.
Sam: Also add unit test that simulates allocator fragmentation and ensures probe won't select >X ws algos.
Jin: I'll own the exporter/trace bits. Alex/Sam can work on probe backoff + safe-fallback.
Alex: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
